entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: RE001 RPG region preview background, landscape 3:2 ratio. Edit target is supplied existing image. A volcanic fantasy region: erupting orange lava fountain between black basalt cliffs, red-hot fissures, a deep rocky basin and distant ash mountains. The reference is erroneously fragmented into disconnected horizontal strips. Rebuild as ONE continuous coherent scene with connected rock walls, terrain and smoky sky, no horizontal strip gaps, no disconnected floating ribbons. Preserve the same orange lava/blue-gray basalt palette and 16-bit game pixel-art language. Entire rectangular canvas must be fully opaque with continuous finished scenery all the way to every edge. Pixel art, crisp deliberate pixel clusters, no photographic blur, no characters, no UI, no words, no frames. Output one image, not a sprite sheet.

Pixel art, crisp deliberate pixel clusters, no photographic blur, no characters, no UI, no words, no frames. Output one image, not a sprite sheet.

Match the reference design, do not invent different equipment. Subject: tempered steel longsword, straight pale silver blade, dark crossguard and brown grip
